title: task.claim — Response
description: 200 OK on success: returns the updated task with claim_holder_id and claim_expires_at set, plus the assigned event written for the claim lease. 409 Conflict on version_mismatch or active competing claim: response body in the 409 case returns the SERVER'S current task body. 410 Gone if operation_id is past retention. Operation-cache replay happens before if_match validation, so a stale-version replay still returns the cached response.

event.description: The assigned event written for this claim lease.
